_readme: production/session-state/active-goals.json — this session's declared intent.
WHAT THIS IS  The goal the designer declared out loud at session start, and the
concrete outcomes that prove it shipped. It exists so intent
survives a compaction, a chat deletion, or a night's sleep —
chat context does not.
WRITTEN BY    /goal-set (primary goal + expected outcomes), /goal-add-minor
(appends to minor_goals_added), /goal-check (writes each outcome
classification back).
READ BY       /goal-check, which runs as step 0 of /session-close and can PAUSE
the close if a critical goal was dropped.
SEEDED BY     the installer's scaffold step. JSON carries no comments, so this
seed is recognised by VALUE, not by a scaffold-seed marker:
primary_goal is null and every list is empty. /goal-check reads
that as 'no goals set this session' and says so — it does not
treat an empty file as a session with nothing achieved.
SHAPE         session_id      : 'YYYY-MM-DD-<workstream>-<topic-slug>'
session_focus   : '<Workstream> x <Activity>'
frozen          : false until the first work-skill fires; while
true, /goal-set refuses to overwrite the primary
goal and offers /goal-add-minor instead
primary_goal    : { text, set_at, expected_outcomes[] }
expected_outcomes must be concrete — an artifact
that exists, a behaviour that runs. 'improved X'
is not verifiable, so it is not an outcome.
minor_goals_added[] : { id: 'MG-N', added_at, text,
outcome: PENDING|PASS|PARTIAL|DROPPED|CARRY }
unresolved_issues[] : { id: 'ISS-NN', text,
status: OPEN|RESOLVING|DEFERRED|ACCEPTED }
audit_log[]         : { ts, event, note } — append only
DELETE THIS   _readme block once the file holds a real session's goals.
